```ejs
<script>
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    // --- CONSTANTS AND VARIABLES ---
    // Deactivation code stored Base64-encoded to avoid plain text in source
    const DEACTIVATION_CODE = atob('Qk9PWUFI')
    const COUNTDOWN_SECONDS = 5
    const isGerman = '<%= locale %>' === 'de'

    let isCountdownActive = false // State to start the countdown only once
    let isValidAction = false

    // --- ELEMENT REFERENCES ---
    const container = document.querySelector('.msg-container')
    const actionSection = document.getElementById('action-section')
    const decryptCheckbox = document.getElementById('decrypt-checkbox')
    const uploadCheckbox = document.getElementById('upload-checkbox')
    const travelCheckbox = document.getElementById('travel-checkbox')
    const deactivationInfo = document.getElementById('deactivation-info')
    const countdownContainer = document.getElementById('countdown-container')

    // Robustness check
    if (!container || !actionSection || !decryptCheckbox) {
      console.error(
        'Erforderliche Elemente für die Skript-Logik nicht gefunden.'
      )
      return
    }

    // --- AUTHENTICATION LOGIC ---
    const correctUsername = window.USERNAME || ''
    if (correctUsername === '') {
      console.warn(
        'window.USERNAME ist nicht gesetzt. Die Authentifizierung wird nicht funktionieren.'
      )
    }

    const checkUsername = () => {
      const currentText = container.innerText || container.textContent
      // Updated regex to be language-agnostic
      const match = currentText.match(/\((username|Nutzername)\): \[(.*?)\]/)
      let placeholder = ''
      if (match && match[2]) {
        placeholder = match[2].trim()
      }

      if (correctUsername && placeholder.includes(correctUsername)) {
        actionSection.style.display = 'inline'
      } else {
        actionSection.style.display = 'none'
      }
    }

    // --- ACTION LOGIC ---
    const checkAction = () => {
      // Only run this function if the section is visible and the countdown is not already active.
      if (actionSection.style.display === 'none' || isCountdownActive) {
        return
      }

      // Check if the user has entered 'X' in the decrypt checkbox.
      // .trim() is important in case the cursor leaves spaces.
      if (decryptCheckbox.innerText.trim().toUpperCase().includes('X')) {
        isCountdownActive = true // Prevents the countdown from starting again.
        isValidAction = true
        startSelfDestructSequence()
        // Mark other options as "unsupported".
        uploadCheckbox.parentElement.classList.add('unsupported')
        travelCheckbox.parentElement.classList.add('unsupported')
      } else if (travelCheckbox.innerText.trim().toUpperCase().includes('X')) {
        isCountdownActive = true
        isValidAction = false
        startSelfDestructSequence()
        decryptCheckbox.parentElement.classList.add('unsupported')
        uploadCheckbox.parentElement.classList.add('unsupported')
      } else if (uploadCheckbox.innerText.trim().toUpperCase().includes('X')) {
        isCountdownActive = true
        isValidAction = false
        startSelfDestructSequence()
        decryptCheckbox.parentElement.classList.add('unsupported')
        travelCheckbox.parentElement.classList.add('unsupported')
      }
    }

    // --- SELF-DESTRUCT SEQUENCE ---
    const startSelfDestructSequence = () => {
      // 1. Block further input and provide visual feedback.
      container.contenteditable = 'false'
      container.style.backgroundColor = '#ffdddd' // light red tint

      // 2. Show deactivation code and warning.
      deactivationInfo.style.display = 'block'
      deactivationInfo.innerHTML = isValidAction
        ? isGerman
          ? `DEAKTIVIERUNGSCODE: <strong>${DEACTIVATION_CODE}</strong><br>SELBSTZERSTÖRUNG EINGELEITET.`
          : `DEACTIVATION CODE: <strong>${DEACTIVATION_CODE}</strong><br>SELF-DESTRUCTION INITIATED.`
        : isGerman
          ? 'AKTION NICHT VERFÜGBAR.<br>SELBSTZERSTÖRUNG EINGELEITET.'
          : 'ACTION NOT AVAILABLE.<br>SELF-DESTRUCTION INITIATED.'

      // 4. Start countdown
      countdownContainer.style.display = 'block'
      let timeLeft = COUNTDOWN_SECONDS

      const countdownInterval = setInterval(() => {
        countdownContainer.innerText = isGerman
          ? `Nachricht zerstört sich in ${timeLeft}...`
          : `Message will self-destruct in ${timeLeft}...`
        timeLeft--

        if (timeLeft < 0) {
          clearInterval(countdownInterval)
          // 5. Destroy message
          const destroyedMsg = isGerman
            ? '-- VERBINDUNG GETRENNT / NACHRICHT ZERSTÖRT --'
            : '-- CONNECTION LOST / MESSAGE DESTROYED --'
          container.innerHTML = `<div id="self-destruct-msg">${destroyedMsg}</div>`
          container.style.backgroundColor = '#333'
        }
      }, 1000)
    }

    // --- EVENT LISTENER ---
    container.addEventListener('input', () => {
      checkUsername()
      checkAction()
    })
  })
</script>
```

```ejs
const { Engine, World, Bodies, Body, Events } = Matter
const { Application, loader, extras, Sprite, Text } = PIXI

const engine = Engine.create(),
  world = engine.world,
  HOLZ = '/chals/chal63/holz.jpg',
  BALL = '/chals/chal63/ball.png'

window.app = new Application(800, 600, { backgroundColor: 0x1099bb })
$('game').replaceChildren(app.view)

function updateScore(newScore) {
  window.score = newScore
  window.setText(newScore.toString())
}

function initGame() {
  const status = new Text('Test')
  app.stage.addChild(status)
  status.x = 30
  status.y = 90

  window.setText = (text) => {
    status.text = text
  }

  <%= locale == 'de' ? `// ============================================
  // ============== SCHAU MAL ===================
  // ============================================
  // = Hier wird die Start-Punkzahl festgelegt, =
  // = die könnntest du z.B. auf 50 setzen.      =
  // ============================================` :
  `// ============================================
  // ============== LOOK HERE ===================
  // ============================================
  // = This is where the starting score is set; =
  // = you could, for example, change it to 50. =
  // ============================================` %>
  updateScore(0)

  const woodTexture = loader.resources[HOLZ].texture

  function buildWoodBlock(x, y, w, h, id) {
    var block = new extras.TilingSprite(woodTexture, w, h)
    app.stage.addChild(block)
    Matter.World.add(
      world,
      Matter.Bodies.rectangle(x + w / 2, y + h / 2, w, h, {
        isStatic: true,
        id,
      })
    )
    block.x = x
    block.y = y
  }

  buildWoodBlock(0, 570, 800, 30, 1)
  buildWoodBlock(0, 170, 30, 400, 2)
  buildWoodBlock(770, 170, 30, 400, 3)
  buildWoodBlock(350, 50, 100, 100, 4)

  const ball = new Sprite(loader.resources[BALL].texture)
  ball.x = 300
  ball.y = 200
  ball.width = 100
  ball.height = 100
  ball.anchor.set(0.5)
  app.stage.addChild(ball)

  let border = undefined

  const circle = Bodies.circle(300, 200, 50, { restitution: 1, id: 5 })
  World.add(world, circle)
  Events.on(engine, 'collisionStart', (data) => {
    if (data.pairs[0].bodyA.id == 1 && data.pairs[0].bodyB.id == 5) {
      updateScore(0)
    } else if (data.pairs[0].bodyA.id == 2 && data.pairs[0].bodyB.id == 5) {
      if (border == undefined) border = 2

      if (data.pairs[0].bodyA.id == border) {
        updateScore(window.score + 1)
        border = 3
      }
    } else if (data.pairs[0].bodyA.id == 3 && data.pairs[0].bodyB.id == 5) {
      if (border == undefined) border = 3

      if (data.pairs[0].bodyA.id == border) {
        updateScore(window.score + 1)
        border = 2
      }
    }
  })

  function handleUp() {
    const angle = Math.random() * 40 - 20 - 90
    const r = (angle / 180) * Math.PI
    Body.applyForce(circle, circle.position, {
      x: Math.cos(r) * 0.24,
      y: Math.sin(r) * 0.24,
    })
  }

  function handleLeft() {
    Body.applyForce(circle, circle.position, { x: -0.2, y: -0.05 })
  }

  function handleRight() {
    Body.applyForce(circle, circle.position, { x: +0.2, y: -0.05 })
  }

  document.handleLeft = handleLeft
  document.handleUp = handleUp
  document.handleRight = handleRight

  $('game-container').onkeydown = (key) => {
    if (key.code == 'ArrowUp') {
      handleUp()
      key.preventDefault()
    }

    if (key.code == 'ArrowLeft') {
      handleLeft()
      key.preventDefault()
    }

    if (key.code == 'ArrowRight') {
      handleRight()
      key.preventDefault()
    }
  }

  $('game-container').focus()

  app.ticker.add(() => {
    Engine.update(engine)
    ball.x = circle.position.x
    ball.y = circle.position.y
  })
}

loader.reset().add(HOLZ).add(BALL).load(initGame)</textarea
```

```ejs
<script>
  const ALPHABET = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'
  const inputText =
    '"Pon fnv Thqrm", nogvd Uwzfoj. Uwzfoj adtkhg pdj Ywjp kw dfjdy nqxfdidj Zäqxdzj. Moptfdz nox klfnqxdj Uwzfoj wjp pdy Ihvh xfj wjp xdt. "Nfd fnv xübnqx", nogvd dt, hxjd gdjow kw lfnndj, lotwy. Dt adtzogdtvd pon Gdlfqxv. "Fnv nfd pdfjd Itdwjpfj?", itogvd dt wjp adtnwqxvd, dn bdfzäwifg rzfjgdj kw zonndj. Uwzfoj nqxjowbvd. "Jdfj." Dt zdxjvd nfqx kwtüqr wjp nvüvkd nfqx owi pfd Dzzbhgdj. "Fqx xobn jfqxv nh yfv Itdwjpfjjdj." Moptfdz adtptdxvd pfd Owgdj wjp zoqxvd nsövvfnqx. "Lfd? Ldfz pw dfj Ywudtfdgh bfnv hpdt lon? Xonv pw kw afdzd Adtdxtdtfjjdj, wy pfqx owi jwt Dfjd dfjkwzonndj?", itogvd dt zdfqxv adtätgdtv. "Jdfj", btwyyvd Uwzfoj, pdj Bzfqr fyydt jhqx owi pon Uoxtbwqx gdtfqxvdv. "Ldfz fqx nqxlwz bfj, pw Otnqxzhqx." Moptfdz bzfjkdzvd. Poyfv ... xovvd dt jfqxv gdtdqxjdv. Dt nvottvd Uwzfoj oj.'

  const key = {}

  for (const char of ALPHABET) {
    key[char] = null
  }
  key['P'] = 'D'
  key['O'] = 'A'
  key['N'] = 'S'
  key['F'] = 'I'
  key['V'] = 'T'
  key['M'] = 'Y'

  renderDecipherKey()
  renderText()

  // ------------- Functions --------------

  function renderDecipherKey() {
    const container = document.querySelector('.decipher-key-container')
    for (const char of ALPHABET) {
      const div = document.createElement('div')
      div.classList.add('key-input-entry')
      div.innerHTML = `<span class="ciphertext-letter">${char}</span><input class="plaintext-letter" maxlength="1" value="${key[char] || ''}">`
      container.appendChild(div)
      div.querySelector('input').addEventListener('input', (e) => {
        const val = e.target.value.toUpperCase()
        if (val === '' || ALPHABET.includes(val)) {
          key[char] = val === '' ? null : val
        } else {
          e.target.value = ''
          key[char] = null
        }
        renderText()
      })
      // on click select text in input
      div.querySelector('input').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.target.select()
      })
    }
  }

  function renderText() {
    const cipherTextContainer = document.querySelector('.ciphertext-container')
    cipherTextContainer.innerHTML = ''
    inputText.split('').forEach((char) => {
      const div = document.createElement('div')
      let deciphered = char
      if (ALPHABET.includes(char.toUpperCase())) {
        if (key[char.toUpperCase()]) {
          deciphered = key[char.toUpperCase()]
          if (char === char.toLowerCase()) {
            deciphered = deciphered.toLowerCase()
          }
        } else {
          deciphered = `<span style="color: #555">${char}</span>`
        }
      }
      div.innerHTML = `<div class="letter font-monospace"><span class="ciphertext">${char}</span><span class="plaintext">${deciphered}</span></div>`
      cipherTextContainer.appendChild(div)
    })
  }
</script>
```

```ejs
    { x: 13, y: 6, z: 0, type: 'block' },
    { x: 13, y: 7, z: 0, type: 'dust', variant: 'line', rotate: 90 },
    // -- -- -- OR + NOT + 2x lever
    { x: 13, y: 8, z: 0, type: 'dust', variant: 'tee', rotate: 270 },
    { x: 12, y: 8, z: 0, type: 'dust', variant: 'corner', rotate: 180 },
    { x: 12, y: 9, z: 0, type: 'dust', variant: 'tee' },
    { x: 11, y: 9, z: 0, type: 'dust', variant: 'corner', rotate: 180 },
    { x: 11, y: 10, z: 0, type: 'dust', variant: 'line', rotate: 90 },
    { x: 11, y: 11, z: 0, type: 'dust', variant: 'line', rotate: 90 },
    { x: 11, y: 12, z: 0, type: 'lever' },
    { x: 13, y: 9, z: 0, type: 'torch', variant: 'wall' },
    { x: 13, y: 10, z: 0, type: 'block' },
    { x: 13, y: 11, z: 0, type: 'dust', variant: 'line', rotate: 90 },
    { x: 13, y: 12, z: 0, type: 'lever' },
  ]

  const offsets = [
    [0, -1, 0], // down
    [0, 1, 0], // up
    [-1, 0, 0], // left
    [1, 0, 0], // right
    [0, 0, -1], // back
    [0, 0, 1], // front
  ]

  const coordMap = {}

  const domImgMap = {}

  const circuitDiv = document.querySelector('.mc-circuit')

  blocks.forEach((block, id) => {
    block.id = id
    block.active = false
    coordMap[`(${block.x}|${block.y}|${block.z})`] = block

    const img = document.createElement('img')
    img.style.position = 'absolute'
    img.style.width = '6.66667%'
    img.style.left = `${block.x * 6.66667}%`
    img.style.top = `${block.y * 7.14286}%`
    img.style.zIndex = block.z + 1
    img.draggable = false

    domImgMap[block.id] = img
    circuitDiv.appendChild(img)

    if (block.type == 'lever') {
      img.classList.add('lever')
      img.style.cursor = 'pointer'
      img.addEventListener('click', () => {
        block.active = !block.active
        render()
      })
    }
  })

  for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
    simulate()
  }

  setInterval(() => {
    simulate()
    render()
  }, 100)

  // translate block types to images
  function render() {
    const solutionBox = document.querySelector('.solution-box')
    solutionBox.style.display = coordMap['(6|1|0)'].active ? 'block' : 'none'
    blocks.forEach(({ id, type, active, variant, rotate }) => {
      const img = domImgMap[id]
      if (type == 'lever') {
        img.src = '/chals/minecraft/lever.png'
        if (active) {
          img.style.transform = 'rotate(180deg)'
          img.style.filter = 'brightness(1.2)'
        } else {
          img.style.transform = 'rotate(0deg)'
          img.style.filter = 'brightness(0.7)'
        }
      } else if (type == 'torch') {
        img.src = `/chals/minecraft/torch_${variant == 'wall' ? 'wall_' : ''}${active ? 'on' : 'off'}.png`
        if (active) {
          img.style.filter = 'brightness(0.8)'
        } else {
          img.style.filter = ''
        }
        if (rotate) {
          img.style.transform = `rotate(${rotate}deg)`
        } else {
          img.style.transform = 'rotate(0deg)'
        }
      } else if (type == 'dust') {
        if (!variant) return // not ready yyet
        // first select image and transformation
        img.src = `/chals/minecraft/dust_${variant}.png`
        if (rotate) {
          img.style.transform = `rotate(${rotate}deg)`
        } else {
          img.style.transform = 'rotate(0deg)'
        }
        if (active) {
          img.style.filter = 'brightness(1.9)'
        } else {
          img.style.filter = 'brightness(0.7)'
        }
      } else if (type == 'block') {
        if (variant == 'lamp') {
          img.src = '/chals/minecraft/lamp.png'
          if (active) {
            img.style.filter = 'brightness(1.9) hue-rotate(40deg)'
          } else {
            img.style.filter = 'brightness(0.4)'
          }
        } else {
          img.src = '/chals/minecraft/moss.png'
          img.style.filter = 'brightness(0.3)'
          // if (active) {
          //   img.style.filter = 'brightness(1.0)'
          // } else {
          //   img.style.filter = 'brightness(0.4)'
          // }
        }
      }
    })
  }

  function simulate() {
    const toProp = []
    blocks.forEach((block) => {
      // mark active levers as to be propagated
      if (block.type == 'lever' && block.active) {
        toProp.push(block)
      }
      // torch sensing
      if (block.type == 'torch') {
        block.active = true
        for (const [dx, dy, dz] of offsets) {
          const neighbor =
            coordMap[`(${block.x + dx}|${block.y + dy}|${block.z + dz})`]
          if (neighbor && neighbor.active && neighbor.type == 'block') {
            block.active = false
            break
          }
        }
        if (block.active) {
          toProp.push(block)
        }
      }
    })
    blocks.forEach((block) => {
      // reset passive blocks
      if (block.type == 'dust' || block.type == 'block') {
        block.active = false
      }
    })

    function propagate(block, dustOnly = false) {
      for (const [dx, dy, dz] of offsets) {
        const neighbor =
          coordMap[`(${block.x + dx}|${block.y + dy}|${block.z + dz})`]
        if (neighbor) {
          if (
            neighbor.type == 'dust' ||
            (!dustOnly && neighbor.type == 'block')
          ) {
            if (!neighbor.active) {
              neighbor.active = true
              if (neighbor.type == 'dust') {
                propagate(neighbor)
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }

    toProp.forEach((block) => {
      propagate(block, true)
    })
  }

  function gotoImg() {
    let key = 'img_'
    blocks.forEach((block) => {
      if (block.type == 'lever') {
        key += block.active ? '1' : '0'
      }
    })
    // open image in new tab
    window.open(`/chals/${key}<%= locale == 'en' ? '_en' : '' %>.png`, '_blank')
  }
</script>
```

```ejs
<script>
  var map = L.map('map', { zoomControl: false }).setView(
    [48.133333, 11.566667],
    6
  )
  const tiles = L.tileLayer('https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
    attribution:
      '&copy; <a href="http://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright" target="_blank">OSM</a>',
  }).addTo(map)

  let currentMarker = null
  let selectedLocation = null

  map.on('click', function (e) {
    const lat = e.latlng.lat
    const lng = e.latlng.lng
    selectedLocation = { lat, lng }
    document.getElementById('submit-btn').style.display = 'block'

    // If a marker already exists, move it. Otherwise, create a new one.
    if (currentMarker) {
      currentMarker.setLatLng(e.latlng)
    } else {
      currentMarker = L.marker(e.latlng).addTo(map)
    }
  })
  const mapDiv = document.getElementById('map-wrapper')
  const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
    map.invalidateSize()
  })

  resizeObserver.observe(mapDiv)

  async function startHoppingProcess() {
    if (isFullscreen) {
      pano.toggleFullscreen()
    }
    // 1. Hide Rabbit Modal (if open)
    document.getElementById('rabbit-modal').style.display = 'none'

    // 2. Show Loading Screen
    const loadingScreen = document.getElementById('loading-screen')
    loadingScreen.style.display = 'flex'

    const res = await fetch('/where-the-hack/check/' + '<%= id %>', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({ answer: JSON.stringify(selectedLocation) }),
    })
    // 3. Async / Wait 2 Seconds
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 2000))

    loadingScreen.style.display = 'none'
    // insert result into check result
    document.getElementById('check-result').innerHTML = await res.text()

    // Show the Rabbit Modal
    document.getElementById('rabbit-modal').style.display = 'flex'
  }

  function closeRabbitModal() {
    document.getElementById('rabbit-modal').style.display = 'none'
    // reset selected location and marker
    selectedLocation = null
    document.getElementById('submit-btn').style.display = 'none'
  }
</script>
```

`src/content/worms/worms-arena.js`:

```js
// This file implements the actual bot fights
import { Worker } from 'node:worker_threads'
import {
  getWormsTranslator,
  renderNavigation,
  wormerMessages,
} from './worms-basic.js'
import { renderPage } from '../../helper/render-page.js'
import escapeHTML from 'escape-html'
import { safeRoute } from '../../helper/helper.js'

/** @type {Int32Array | null} */
let currentProgress = null
let queueChain = Promise.resolve()

/**
 * @typedef {object} LiveMatch
 * @property {number} matchId
 * @property {import('../../data/types.js').WormsStart | null} start
 * @property {number[]} dirs
 * @property {boolean} aborted
 * @property {() => boolean} abort returns false if the match already ended
 * @property {number} sent moves that already went out to the viewers
 * @property {ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null} sendTimer
 */

/**
 * The match that is currently running, moves are streamed in from the worker
 * @type {LiveMatch | null}
 */
let liveMatch = null

/** ids of matches that wait in the queue and were not cancelled */
const pendingMatches = new Set()

/** users whose start-match request is being handled right now */
const startingUsers = new Set()

/**
 * Viewers of a match are connected by socket.io and sit in one room per
 * match. They get the state when it changes and the moves as they come in.
 * @type {import('socket.io').Server | null}
 */
let io = null

/** @param {number} matchId */
function matchRoom(matchId) {
  return 'worms-match-' + matchId
}

/**
 * State of a match that is waiting or running, without a database query
 * @param {number} matchId
 * @param {number} from moves the viewer already has
 */
function liveState(matchId, from) {
  if (liveMatch && liveMatch.matchId == matchId) {
    return {
      id: matchId,
      status: 'running',
      start: liveMatch.start,
      at: from,
      dirs: liveMatch.start ? liveMatch.dirs.slice(from) : [],
    }
  }
  const queue = [...pendingMatches]
  const index = queue.indexOf(matchId)
  if (index >= 0) {
    return { id: matchId, status: 'pending', queuePosition: index + 1 }
  }
  return null
}

/**
 * State of a finished match
 * @param {number} matchId
 * @param {import('../../data/types.js').WormsReplay} replay
 */
function finishedState(matchId, replay) {
  return {
    id: matchId,
    status: replay.winner == 'red' ? 'red-win' : 'green-win',
    finished: true,
    replay: {
      dirs: replay.dirs,
      withCrash: !!replay.withCrash,
      aborted: !!replay.aborted,
    },
  }
}

/**
 * @param {number} matchId
 * @param {object | null} state
 */
function emitState(matchId, state) {
  if (state) io?.to(matchRoom(matchId)).emit('worms:state', state)
}

/** the place in the queue changes for everyone waiting */
function emitQueue() {
  let position = 1
  for (const matchId of pendingMatches) {
    emitState(matchId, {
      id: matchId,
      status: 'pending',
      queuePosition: position++,
    })
  }
}

/**
 * Send the new moves to the viewers. Fast bots make thousands of moves per
 * second, so moves that arrive within one frame go out together.
 * @param {LiveMatch} live
 */
function sendMoves(live) {
  if (live.sendTimer) {
    clearTimeout(live.sendTimer)
    live.sendTimer = null
  }
  if (live.sent >= live.dirs.length) return
  io?.to(matchRoom(live.matchId)).emit('worms:moves', {
    id: live.matchId,
    at: live.sent,
    dirs: live.dirs.slice(live.sent),
  })
  live.sent = live.dirs.length
}

/**
 * Replay of a cancelled match: red loses, unfinished half-moves are dropped
 * @param {LiveMatch | null} live
 * @returns {import('../../data/types.js').WormsReplay}
 */
function abortedReplay(live) {
  const start = live?.start ?? {
    xRed: -1,
    yRed: -1,
    dirRed: -1,
    xGreen: -1,
    yGreen: -1,
    dirGreen: -1,
  }
  const dirs = live ? live.dirs.slice(0, live.dirs.length & ~1) : []
  return {
    ...start,
    dirs,
    winner: 'green',
    aborted: true,
    redElo: -1,
    greenElo: -1,
  }
}

/**
 * Serialize matches: only one match runs at a time.
 * @template T
 * @param {() => Promise<T>} fn
 * @returns {Promise<T>}
 */
function enqueue(fn) {
  const run = queueChain.then(fn, fn)
  queueChain = run.then(
    () => {},
    () => {}
  )
  return run
}

/**
 * Run a match in a dedicated worker thread.
 * @param {string} redCode
 * @param {string} greenCode
 * @param {LiveMatch} live receives start position and moves while the match runs
 * @returns {Promise<import('../../data/types.js').WormsReplay>}
 */
function runWormsInWorker(redCode, greenCode, live) {
  const progress = new SharedArrayBuffer(4)
  currentProgress = new Int32Array(progress)
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const worker = new Worker(new URL('./worms-worker.js', import.meta.url), {
      workerData: { redCode, greenCode, progress },
    })
    let settled = false
    /** @param {() => void} fn */
    const finish = (fn) => {
      if (settled) return
      settled = true
      currentProgress = null
      // the result contains all moves, no need to send the rest
      if (live.sendTimer) {
        clearTimeout(live.sendTimer)
        live.sendTimer = null
      }
      worker.terminate()
      fn()
    }
    live.abort = () => {
      if (settled) return false
      live.aborted = true
      finish(() => resolve(abortedReplay(live)))
      return true
    }
    worker.on('message', (msg) => {
      if (msg?.type == 'start') {
        live.start = msg.start
        emitState(live.matchId, liveState(live.matchId, 0))
      } else if (msg?.type == 'move') {
        live.dirs.push(msg.dir)
        if (!live.sendTimer) {
          live.sendTimer = setTimeout(() => sendMoves(live), 16)
        }
      } else if (msg?.type == 'done') {
        finish(() => {
          if (msg.ok) {
            resolve(msg.replay)
          } else {
            reject(new Error(msg.error ? msg.error : 'worker failed'))
          }
        })
      }
    })
    worker.once('error', (err) => {
      finish(() => reject(err))
    })
    // otherwise the queue would wait forever if the worker dies silently
    worker.once('exit', () => {
      finish(() => reject(new Error('worker exited without result')))
    })
  })
}

/**
 * Update ELO of both bots and store the result of a match
 * @param {import("../../data/types.js").App} App
 * @param {number} matchId
 * @param {number} redBotId
 * @param {number} greenBotId
 * @param {import('../../data/types.js').WormsReplay} replay
 */
async function finishMatch(App, matchId, redBotId, greenBotId, replay) {
  // load elo of bots
  const [botELO, opponentELO] = await Promise.all([
    App.wormsData.getBotElo(redBotId),
    App.wormsData.getBotElo(greenBotId),
  ])

  replay.redElo = botELO
  replay.greenElo = opponentELO

  const K = 32

  let S = 0
  if (replay.winner == 'red') {
    S = 1
  } else if (replay.winner == 'green') {
    S = 0
  }

  const E = 1 / (1 + 10 ** ((opponentELO - botELO) / 400))

  const newBotELO = botELO + K * (S - E)
  const newOpponentELO = opponentELO + K * (E - S)

  await App.wormsData.setBotElos([
    { botId: redBotId, elo: newBotELO },
    { botId: greenBotId, elo: newOpponentELO },
  ])

  await App.wormsData.finishMatch({
    id: matchId,
    status: replay.winner == 'red' ? 'red-win' : 'green-win',
    replay,
  })
}

/**
 * @typedef {object} ArenaBotStats
 * @property {number} wins
 * @property {number} losses
 * @property {{id: number, won: boolean, opponentId: number | null, createdAt: number}[]} matches newest first, at most 10
 */

/**
 * @typedef {object} ArenaStats
 * @property {Map<number, ArenaBotStats>} bots
 * @property {import('../../data/types.js').WormsMatchMeta[]} lastMatches newest first, at most 40
 */

/**
 * @param {import("../../data/types.js").App} App
 * @returns {Promise<ArenaStats>}
 */
async function buildArenaStats(App) {
  const matches = await App.wormsData.getFinishedMatches()

  /** @type {Map<number, ArenaBotStats>} */
  const bots = new Map()
  /** @param {number} id */
  const statsOf = (id) => {
    let stats = bots.get(id)
    if (!stats) {
      stats = { wins: 0, losses: 0, matches: [] }
      bots.set(id, stats)
    }
    return stats
  }

  for (const match of matches) {
    const redWon = match.status == 'red-win'

    if (match.redBotId != null) {
      const red = statsOf(match.redBotId)
      if (red.matches.length < 10) {
        red.matches.push({
          id: match.id,
          won: redWon,
          opponentId: match.greenBotId,
          createdAt: match.createdAt,
        })
      }
      if (redWon) {
        red.wins++
      } else {
        red.losses++
      }
    }
    if (match.greenBotId != null) {
      const green = statsOf(match.greenBotId)
      if (green.matches.length < 10) {
        green.matches.push({
          id: match.id,
          won: !redWon,
          opponentId: match.redBotId,
          createdAt: match.createdAt,
        })
      }
      if (redWon) {
        green.losses++
      } else {
        green.wins++
      }
    }
  }

  return {
    bots,
    lastMatches: matches.slice(0, 40),
  }
}

/**
 * @param {import("../../data/types.js").App} App
 * @param {import('../../data/types.js').WormsMatchMeta} match
 * @returns {Promise<number>}
 */
async function getQueuePosition(App, match) {
  const pending = await App.wormsData.getPendingMatches()
  const index = pending.findIndex((entry) => entry.id == match.id)
  return index >= 0 ? index + 1 : 1
}

/**
 * Status line shown while waiting for a match
 * @param {import("../../data/types.js").App} App
 * @param {import('../../data/types.js').WormsMatchMeta} match
 * @param {import('i18next').TFunction} t
 * @returns {Promise<string>}
 */
async function getMatchStatusText(App, match, t) {
  if (match.status == 'running') {
    const steps = currentProgress ? Atomics.load(currentProgress, 0) : 0
    return steps == 0
      ? t('worms.arena.matchRunningLong')
      : `${t('worms.arena.matchRunning')} (${t('worms.arena.step')} ${steps})`
  }

  if (match.status == 'pending') {
    const queuePos = await getQueuePosition(App, match)
    return `${t('worms.arena.matchQueued')} ${queuePos} ...`
  }

  if (match.status == 'error') {
    return t('worms.arena.matchError')
  }

  if (match.status == 'cancelled') {
    // If you've added a translation key for cancelled, use it here:
    return t('worms.arena.matchCancelled')
  }

  return match.status
}

/**
 *
 * @param {import("../../data/types.js").App} App
 */
export function setupWormsArena(App) {
  App.entry.add(async () => {
    // safe guard: if there is still a running match, we reset it
    await App.wormsData.resetOpenMatches()
  })

  App.express.get_async_fix('/worms/arena', async (req, res) => {
    const user = req.user
    if (!user) {
      res.redirect('/')
      return
    }

    // only one match per person in the queue: while it waits or runs, the
    // overview links to it and no new match can be started
    const ownMatch = await App.wormsData.getOpenMatchForUser(user.id)

    const liveMeta = liveMatch
      ? await App.wormsData.getMatch(liveMatch.matchId)
      : null

    const liveArenaMatch =
      liveMeta && liveMeta.status == 'running' ? liveMeta : null

    // names of the bots in both matches, in one query
    const bannerBotIds = []
    for (const m of [ownMatch, liveArenaMatch]) {
      if (!m) continue
      if (m.redBotId != null) bannerBotIds.push(m.redBotId)
      if (m.greenBotId != null) bannerBotIds.push(m.greenBotId)
    }
    const bannerBots = await App.wormsData.getBotsByIds(bannerBotIds)

    /** @param {number | null} id */
    const bannerName = (id) => bannerBots.find((b) => b.id == id)?.name ?? null

    const eloById = await App.wormsData.getBotElos()
    const achievements = await App.wormsData.getBotAchievements()

    // names change when bots are renamed or deleted, so they are always fresh
    const bots = await App.wormsData.getBotsByIds([...eloById.keys()])

    const users = await App.db.models.User.findAll({
      where: {
        id: bots.map((b) => b.userId),
      },
      attributes: ['id', 'name'],
    })
    const userNameById = new Map(users.map((u) => [u.id, u.name]))
    const botById = new Map(
      bots.map((bot) => [
        bot.id,
        {
          name: bot.name,
          userid: bot.userId,
          username: userNameById.get(bot.userId) ?? '',
        },
      ])
    )

    const stats = await buildArenaStats(App)

    /** @param {number} date */
    const fromNow = (date) => App.moment(date).locale(req.lng).fromNow()

    const sevenDaysAgo = App.moment().subtract(7, 'days').valueOf()

    /** @type {{id: number, elo: number, name: string, medal: boolean, rainbow: boolean, userid: number, username: string, wins: number, losses: number, matches: {id: number; won: boolean; opponentName: string | null; dateFromNow: string}[]}[]}} */
    const botData = []
    for (const [id, elo] of eloById) {
      const bot = botById.get(id)
      if (!bot || !bot.name || !bot.username) continue
      const botStats = stats.bots.get(id) ?? {
        wins: 0,
        losses: 0,
        matches: [],
      }
      const winRate =
        botStats.matches.length > 0
          ? botStats.wins / (botStats.wins + botStats.losses)
          : 0
      const recentMatch = botStats.matches.some(
        (match) => match.createdAt > sevenDaysAgo
      )
      if (winRate < 0.2 && !recentMatch) continue

      // "rising star" logic:
      // I'm looking at the streak with in the last 10 matches
      // this streak should contain at least 5 normally strong bots, e.g. ELO > 500
      // the limit is relatively low, as bot ELO will generally decrease after a win
      // so we are more generous
      const streakIndex = botStats.matches
        .slice(0, 10)
        .findIndex((match) => !match.won)
      const streaks = botStats.matches.slice(0, streakIndex)
      let strongOpponents = 0
      for (const match of streaks) {
        const opp = match.opponentId
        if (opp !== null) {
          const elo = await App.wormsData.getBotElo(opp)
          if (elo > 500) {
            strongOpponents++
          }
        }
      }
      const rainbow = strongOpponents >= 5
      botData.push({
        id,
        elo,
        name: bot.name,
        medal: achievements.has(id),
        rainbow,
        userid: bot.userid,
        username: bot.username,
        wins: botStats.wins,
        losses: botStats.losses,
        matches: botStats.matches.map((match) => ({
          id: match.id,
          won: match.won,
          opponentName:
            match.opponentId == null
              ? null
              : (botById.get(match.opponentId)?.name ?? null),
          dateFromNow: fromNow(match.createdAt),
        })),
      })
    }

    botData.sort((a, b) => b.elo - a.elo)

    const ownBots = await App.wormsData.getBotsForUser(user.id)

    // find out number of matches in last 24h from this player, only the time
    // is needed, not the replays
    const since24h = App.moment().subtract(24, 'hours').valueOf()

    const matchesInTheLast24h = await App.wormsData.getMatchesForUser(user.id, {
      since: since24h,
    })

    req.session.lastWormsTab = 'arena'

    const lastMatches = stats.lastMatches.map((match) => {
      const redBot = match.redBotId == null ? null : botById.get(match.redBotId)
      const greenBot =
        match.greenBotId == null ? null : botById.get(match.greenBotId)
      return {
        id: match.id,
        redName: redBot ? redBot.name : null,
        redUsername: redBot ? redBot.username : null,
        greenName: greenBot ? greenBot.name : null,
        greenUsername: greenBot ? greenBot.username : null,
        redWon: match.status == 'red-win',
        greenWon: match.status == 'green-win',
        dateFromNow: fromNow(match.createdAt),
      }
    })

    const limitReached = matchesInTheLast24h.length >= 50
    const oldestRecentMatch =
      matchesInTheLast24h[matchesInTheLast24h.length - 1]
    const limitUntil =
      limitReached && oldestRecentMatch
        ? App.moment(oldestRecentMatch.createdAt + 1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)
            .locale(req.lng)
            .fromNow()
        : null

    renderPage(App, req, res, {
      page: 'worms-arena',
      heading: 'Worms',
      backButton: false,
      props: {
        navigation: renderNavigation(2, req, App),
        ownMatch: ownMatch
          ? {
              id: ownMatch.id,
              redName: bannerName(ownMatch.redBotId),
              greenName: bannerName(ownMatch.greenBotId),
              running: ownMatch.status == 'running',
            }
          : null,
        liveMatch:
          liveArenaMatch && liveArenaMatch.id != ownMatch?.id
            ? {
                id: liveArenaMatch.id,
                redName: bannerName(liveArenaMatch.redBotId),
                greenName: bannerName(liveArenaMatch.greenBotId),
              }
            : null,
        lastMatches,
        bots: botData.map((bot) => ({
          id: bot.id,
          name: bot.name,
          medal: bot.medal,
          rainbow: bot.rainbow,
          username: bot.username,
          isOwn: bot.userid == user.id,
          elo: Math.round(bot.elo),
          wins: bot.wins,
          losses: bot.losses,
          matches: bot.matches,
        })),
        ownBots: ownBots.map((bot) => ({
          id: bot.id,
          name: bot.name,
          selected: bot.id === req.session.lastWormsBotId,
        })),
        matchCount24h: matchesInTheLast24h.length,
        limitUntil,
        canChallenge: !ownMatch,
      },
    })
  })

  App.express.post(
    '/worms/arena/start-match',
    safeRoute(async (req, res) => {
      const user = req.user
      if (!user) {
        res.redirect('/')
        return
      }

      // Server-side match limit check
      const since24h = App.moment().subtract(24, 'hours').valueOf()
      const matches24h = await App.wormsData.getMatchesForUser(user.id, {
        since: since24h,
      })

      if (matches24h.length >= 50) {
        res.status(429).send('Match limit exceeded')
        return
      }

      const botId = req.body?.bot ? parseInt(req.body.bot.toString()) : NaN
      const opponentId = req.body?.opponent
        ? parseInt(req.body.opponent.toString())
        : NaN

      if (botId == opponentId) {
        res.redirect('/worms/arena')
        return
      }

      const bot = await App.wormsData.getBotForUser(botId, user.id)
      const opponentBot = await App.wormsData.getBot(opponentId)

      if (!bot || !opponentBot) {
        res.redirect('/worms/arena')
        return
      }

      // only against bots of other people, otherwise elo could be farmed
      // with a weak bot of your own
      if (opponentBot.userId == user.id) {
        res.redirect('/worms/arena')
        return
      }

      const [botCode, opponentCode] = await Promise.all([
        App.wormsData.getBotCode(bot.id),
        App.wormsData.getBotCode(opponentBot.id),
      ])

      if (botCode == null || opponentCode == null) {
        res.redirect('/worms/arena')
        return
      }

      // fairness: only one match per person in the queue (waiting or
      // running), nobody can block the arena for a long time
      if (startingUsers.has(user.id)) {
        res.redirect('/worms/arena')
        return
      }
      startingUsers.add(user.id)
      let match
      try {
        const ownMatch = await App.wormsData.getOpenMatchForUser(user.id)
        if (ownMatch) {
          res.redirect('/worms/arena/match?id=' + ownMatch.id)
          return
        }
        match = await App.wormsData.createMatch({
          userId: user.id,
          redBotId: bot.id,
          greenBotId: opponentBot.id,
        })
      } finally {
        startingUsers.delete(user.id)
      }

      req.session.lastWormsBotId = bot.id

      pendingMatches.add(match.id)
      emitQueue()

      setTimeout(async () => {
        try {
          await enqueue(async () => {
            // match was cancelled while waiting
            if (!pendingMatches.delete(match.id)) return

            /** @type {LiveMatch} */
            const live = {
              matchId: match.id,
              start: null,
              dirs: [],
              sent: 0,
              sendTimer: null,
              aborted: false,
              // before the worker runs, the flag is checked below
              abort: () => {
                live.aborted = true
                return true
              },
            }
            liveMatch = live
            emitQueue()
            emitState(match.id, liveState(match.id, 0))

            try {
              await App.wormsData.markMatchRunning(match.id)

              const replay = live.aborted
                ? abortedReplay(live)
                : await runWormsInWorker(botCode, opponentCode, live)

              await finishMatch(App, match.id, bot.id, opponentBot.id, replay)
              // not live any more, before the viewers hear about the result
              if (liveMatch === live) liveMatch = null
              emitState(match.id, finishedState(match.id, replay))
            } finally {
              if (liveMatch === live) liveMatch = null
            }
          })
        } catch (e) {
          console.log('match failed', e)
          await App.wormsData.markMatchError(match.id)
          emitState(match.id, { id: match.id, status: 'error' })
        }
      }, 0)

      res.redirect('/worms/arena/match?id=' + match.id)
    })
  )

  App.express.get(
    '/worms/arena/match',
    safeRoute(async (req, res) => {
      const t = getWormsTranslator(App, req)
      const user = req.user
      if (!user) {
        res.redirect('/')
        return
      }

      // match id
      const matchId = req.query.id ? parseInt(req.query.id.toString()) : NaN

      const match = await App.wormsData.getMatch(matchId)

      if (!match) {
        res.status(404).send('Not found')
        return
      }

      const redBot =
        match.redBotId == null
          ? null
          : await App.wormsData.getBot(match.redBotId)
      const greenBot =
        match.greenBotId == null
          ? null
          : await App.wormsData.getBot(match.greenBotId)

      const canCancel =
        match.userId == user.id &&
        (match.status == 'pending' || match.status == 'running')
      const pending = match.status == 'pending'

      renderPage(App, req, res, {
        page: 'worms-match-running',
        heading: 'Worms',
        backButton: false,
        props: {
          navigation: renderNavigation(2, req, App),
          canCancel,
          pending,
          redName: redBot ? redBot.name : null,
          greenName: greenBot ? greenBot.name : null,
          matchId: match.id,
          matchStatus: match.status,
          wormerMessages: wormerMessages(t),
          replayUrl:
            '/worms/arena/replay?id=' +
            match.id +
            (match.userId == user.id ? '&msg=done' : ''),
        },
      })
    })
  )

  io = App.io
  App.io.on('connection', (socket) => {
    // a viewer wants to follow a match, `from` = moves it already has
    socket.on('worms:watch', async (msg) => {
      const matchId = parseInt(msg?.id)
      const from = Math.max(0, parseInt(msg?.from) || 0)
      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(matchId)) return

      // one match per connection
      for (const room of socket.rooms) {
        if (room != socket.id) socket.leave(room)
      }
      // join first: every change after this point reaches the viewer, every
      // change before is already in the database
      socket.join(matchRoom(matchId))

      try {
        const match = await App.wormsData.getMatch(matchId)
        if (!match) {
          socket.leave(matchRoom(matchId))
          socket.emit('worms:state', { id: matchId, status: 'missing' })
          return
        }
        // waiting and running are kept in memory and always up to date
        const live = liveState(matchId, from)
        if (live) {
          socket.emit('worms:state', live)
        } else if (match.status == 'red-win' || match.status == 'green-win') {
          const replay = await App.wormsData.getMatchReplay(matchId)
          if (replay) {
            socket.emit('worms:state', finishedState(matchId, replay))
          } else {
            socket.emit('worms:state', { id: matchId, status: 'error' })
          }
        } else if (match.status == 'error' || match.status == 'cancelled') {
          socket.emit('worms:state', { id: matchId, status: match.status })
        }
        // otherwise the match changed while it was loaded, that change is
        // sent to the room anyway
      } catch (e) {
        socket.emit('worms:state', { id: matchId, status: 'error' })
      }
    })
  })

  App.express.post(
    '/worms/arena/cancel-match',
    safeRoute(async (req, res) => {
      const user = req.user
      if (!user) {
        res.sendStatus(401)
        return
      }

      const matchId = req.body?.id ? parseInt(req.body.id.toString()) : NaN

      const match = await App.wormsData.getMatchForUser(matchId, user.id)

      if (!match) {
        res.sendStatus(404)
        return
      }

      // what the user confirmed: 'pending' = cancel without rating,
      // 'running' = give up
      const expect = (req.body?.expect ?? '').toString()

      // running: giving up counts as a loss
      if (liveMatch && liveMatch.matchId == match.id) {
        if (expect == 'pending') {
          // started in the meantime, the user did not agree to a loss
          res.sendStatus(409)
          return
        }
        res.sendStatus(liveMatch.abort() ? 200 : 409)
        return
      }

      // still waiting in the queue: the match never started, so it is just
      // dropped without any rating
      if (pendingMatches.delete(match.id)) {
        await App.wormsData.cancelMatch(match.id)
        emitState(match.id, { id: match.id, status: 'cancelled' })
        emitQueue()
        res.sendStatus(200)
        return
      }

      // match is already finished
      res.sendStatus(409)
    })
  )

  App.express.get(
    '/worms/arena/poll-match',
    safeRoute(async (req, res) => {
      const t = getWormsTranslator(App, req)
      const user = req.user
      if (!user) {
        res.redirect('/')
        return
      }

      const matchId = req.query.id ? parseInt(req.query.id.toString()) : NaN

      const match = await App.wormsData.getMatch(matchId)

      if (!match) {
        res.status(404).send('Not found')
        return
      }

      res.send(
        await getMatchStatusText(App, match, getWormsTranslator(App, req))
      )
    })
  )

  App.express.get(
    '/worms/arena/replay',
    safeRoute(async (req, res) => {
      const t = getWormsTranslator(App, req)
      const matchId = req.query.id ? parseInt(req.query.id.toString()) : NaN

      const backToBot = req.query.backToBot

      const match = await App.wormsData.getMatch(matchId)

      if (!match) {
        res.redirect('/worms/arena')
        return
      }

      // no replay yet (waiting or running) or never (cancelled, error)
      if (match.status != 'red-win' && match.status != 'green-win') {
        res.redirect('/worms/arena/match?id=' + match.id)
        return
      }

      // "your bot won/lost" only makes sense for the one who started the match
      const showMsg =
        req.query.msg == 'done' && !!req.user && match.userId == req.user.id

      const replay = await App.wormsData.getMatchReplay(match.id)
      if (!replay) {
        res.redirect('/worms/arena')
        return
      }

      const redBot =
        match.redBotId == null
          ? null
          : await App.wormsData.getBot(match.redBotId)
      const greenBot =
        match.greenBotId == null
          ? null
          : await App.wormsData.getBot(match.greenBotId)

      const redBotELO = redBot
        ? Math.trunc(await App.wormsData.getBotElo(redBot.id))
        : 500

      if (showMsg && !redBot) {
        res.redirect('/worms/arena')
        return
      }

      const eloDiff = redBotELO - replay.redElo

      // coming from the live view: show final board without animation
      const instant = req.query.instant == '1'

      // cancelled before the first move
      const hasBoard = replay.xRed >= 0

      const redHtml = redBot
        ? escapeHTML(redBot.name)
        : `[<i>${t('worms.arena.deletedBot')}</i>]`
      const greenHtml = greenBot
        ? escapeHTML(greenBot.name)
        : `[<i>${t('worms.arena.deletedBot')}</i>]`

      renderPage(App, req, res, {
        page: 'worms-match-replay',
        heading: 'Worms',
        backButton: false,
        backHref: '/worms/arena',
        props: {
          navigation: renderNavigation(2, req, App),
          redWon: match.status == 'red-win',
          greenWon: match.status == 'green-win',
          redName: redBot ? redBot.name : null,
          greenName: greenBot ? greenBot.name : null,
          redElo: Math.round(replay.redElo),
          greenElo: Math.round(replay.greenElo),
          showMsg,
          resultTextKey: replay.aborted
            ? 'worms.arena.resultForfeited'
            : match.status == 'red-win'
              ? 'worms.arena.resultWon'
              : 'worms.arena.resultLost',
          redHtml,
          greenHtml,
          redBotElo: redBotELO,
          eloDiff: Math.round(eloDiff),
          updatedFromNow: App.moment(match.updatedAt).locale(req.lng).fromNow(),
          aborted: replay.aborted,
          instant,
          hasBoard,
          backHref: backToBot
            ? '/worms/arena/bot-history?id=' + backToBot
            : '/worms/arena',
          wormerMessages: wormerMessages(t),
          replay,
        },
      })
    })
  )

  App.express.get(
    '/worms/arena/bot-history',
    safeRoute(async (req, res) => {
      const botId = req.query.id ? parseInt(req.query.id.toString()) : NaN

      const bot = await App.wormsData.getBot(botId)

      if (!bot) {
        res.redirect('/worms/arena')
        return
      }

      const botELO = await App.wormsData.getBotElo(bot.id)

      const player = await App.db.models.User.findOne({
        where: {
          id: bot.userId,
        },
      })

      if (!player) {
        res.redirect('/worms/arena')
        return
      }

      const matches = await App.wormsData.getMatchesForBot(bot.id, {
        onlyFinished: true,
      })

      /** @type {number[]} */
      const opponentIds = []
      for (const match of matches) {
        const opponentId =
          match.redBotId == bot.id ? match.greenBotId : match.redBotId

        if (opponentId != null && !opponentIds.includes(opponentId)) {
          opponentIds.push(opponentId)
        }
      }

      const opponents = await App.wormsData.getBotsByIds(opponentIds)
      const replays = await App.wormsData.getMatchReplays(
        matches.map((match) => match.id)
      )

      const elos = []

      elos.push(botELO)

      matches.forEach((match) => {
        const replay = replays.get(match.id)
        if (!replay) return

        if (match.redBotId == bot.id) {
          elos.push(replay.redElo)
        } else if (match.greenBotId == bot.id) {
          elos.push(replay.greenElo)
        }
      })

      elos.reverse()

      const history = matches.map((match) => {
        const opponent =
          match.redBotId == bot.id
            ? opponents.find((opp) => opp.id == match.greenBotId)
            : opponents.find((opp) => opp.id == match.redBotId)
        return {
          id: match.id,
          opponentName: opponent ? opponent.name : null,
          won:
            (match.status == 'red-win' && match.redBotId == bot.id) ||
            (match.status == 'green-win' && match.greenBotId == bot.id),
          dateFromNow: App.moment(match.createdAt).locale(req.lng).fromNow(),
        }
      })

      renderPage(App, req, res, {
        page: 'worms-bot-history',
        heading: 'Worms',
        backButton: false,
        props: {
          navigation: renderNavigation(2, req, App),
          botId: bot.id,
          botName: bot.name,
          botElo: Math.round(botELO),
          playerName: player.name,
          elos,
          matches: history,
        },
      })
    })
  )
}
```

```js
import { safeRoute } from '../../helper/helper.js'
import { renderPage } from '../../helper/render-page.js'

/**
 *
 * @param {number} active active index
 * @param {import('express').Request} req
 * @param {import('../../data/types.js').App} App
 * @returns string
 */
export function renderNavigation(active, req, App) {
  const t = getWormsTranslator(App, req)

  return `
  <style>
    /* phones: one row to swipe through instead of three rows of tabs */
    @media (max-width: 575px) {
      .worms-nav { flex-wrap: nowrap; overflow-x: auto; overflow-y: hidden; white-space: nowrap; scrollbar-width: none; }
      .worms-nav::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
      .worms-nav .nav-link { padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; }
    }
  </style>
  <ul class="nav nav-tabs worms-nav" id="worms-nav" style="margin-bottom: 24px;">
    <li class="nav-item">
      <a class="nav-link" style="color: var(--main-color); border: none;" href="/map">${t('worms.navigation.back')}</a>
    </li>
    <li class="nav-item">
      <a class="nav-link${active == 0 ? ' active' : ''}" href="/worms/two-player">${t('worms.navigation.twoPlayer')}</a>
    </li>
    <li class="nav-item">
      <a class="nav-link${active == 1 ? ' active' : ''}" href="/worms/single-player">${t('worms.navigation.singlePlayer')}</a>
    </li>
    <li class="nav-item">
      <a class="nav-link${active == 2 ? ' active' : ''}" href="/worms/arena">${t('worms.navigation.arena')}</a>
    </li>
    <li class="nav-item">
      <a class="nav-link${active == 3 ? ' active' : ''}" href="/worms/your-bots">${t('worms.navigation.yourBots')}</a>
    </li>
    <li class="nav-item">
      <a class="nav-link${active == 4 ? ' active' : ''}" href="/worms/guide">${t('worms.navigation.guide')}</a>
    </li>
  </ul>
  <script>
    // the active tab may be outside the visible part of the row
    ;(() => {
      const nav = document.getElementById('worms-nav')
      const active = nav.querySelector('.active')
      if (active && nav.scrollWidth > nav.clientWidth) {
        nav.scrollLeft +=
          active.getBoundingClientRect().left -
          nav.getBoundingClientRect().left -
          16
      }
    })()
  </script>`
}

/**
 * @param {import('../../data/types.js').App} App
 * @param {import('express').Request} req
 */
export function getWormsTranslator(App, req) {
  const i18n = App.i18n.get(req.lng)
  return i18n.t.bind(i18n)
}

/**
 * Messages for the Wormer class (public/worms/wormer.js)
 * @param {(key: string) => string} t
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function wormerMessages(t) {
  return toScriptJson({
    redWins: t('worms.wormer.redWins'),
    greenWins: t('worms.wormer.greenWins'),
    matchAborted: t('worms.wormer.matchAborted'),
    opponentCrashed: t('worms.wormer.opponentCrashed'),
    restart: t('worms.wormer.restart'),
    pressToStart: t('worms.wormer.pressToStart'),
  })
}

/**
 * JSON that is safe inside a script tag (no "</script>")
 * @param {any} value
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function toScriptJson(value) {
  return JSON.stringify(value).replace(/</g, '\\u003c')
}

/**
 * @param {string} content
 * @param {(key: string) => string} germanT
 * @param {(key: string) => string} t
 * @returns {string}
 */
function translateGuideExamples(content, germanT, t) {
  const replacements = [
    'wallsAreGreat',
    'pureChance',
    'coilCoil',
    'turned45Degrees',
    'snailHouse',
    'headToHead',
    'zigzagDirection',
    'direction',
    'width',
    'height',
    'board',
    'boardValues',
    'xCoordinate',
    'yCoordinate',
    'directionValues',
    'opponentX',
    'opponentY',
    'newDirection',
    'deadEnd',
    'canMove',
    'calculateDifferences',
    'prioritizeDirections',
    'rightOrLeft',
    'downOrUp',
    'chooseAlternative',
    'keepDirection',
    'writeCode',
    'dirUp',
    'dirRight',
    'dirDown',
    'dirLeft',
    'allBlocked',
  ]

  return replacements.reduce(
    (result, key) =>
      result
        .replaceAll(
          germanT(`worms.guide.examples.source.${key}`),
          t(`worms.guide.examples.source.${key}`)
        )
        .replaceAll(
          t(`worms.guide.examples.source.${key}`),
          t(`worms.guide.examples.${key}`)
        ),
    content
  )
}
```

```js
}

/**
 * True if the code is still exactly the template, in any language (or with the
 * raw template keys, from when they were missing). Then the editor may show the
 * template in the user's language. Anything the user wrote must stay untouched.
 * @param {import("../../data/types.js").App} App
 * @param {string} code
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
function isUntouchedTemplate(App, code) {
  /** @param {string} text */
  const normalize = (text) =>
    text
      .replace(/\r\n/g, '\n')
      .replace(/[ \t]+$/gm, '')
      .trim()
  const templates = App.config.languages.map((lng) => {
    const i18n = App.i18n.get(lng)
    return getDefaultBotCode(i18n.t.bind(i18n))
  })
  templates.push(getDefaultBotCode((key) => key))
  return templates.map(normalize).includes(normalize(code))
}

/**
 *
 * @param {import("../../data/types.js").App} App
 */
export function setupWormsManagement(App) {
  App.express.get(
    '/worms/your-bots',
    safeRoute(async (req, res) => {
      const t = getWormsTranslator(App, req)
      const user = req.user
      if (!user) {
        res.redirect('/')
        return
      }

      if (App.config.demos.includes(user.name)) {
        return renderPage(App, req, res, {
          page: 'worms-drafts',
          heading: 'Worms',
          backButton: false,
          content: `
            ${renderNavigation(3, req, App)}

            <p>${t('worms.management.demoInvite')}</p>
          `,
        })
      }

      const bots = await App.wormsData.getBotsForUser(user.id)

      req.session.lastWormsTab = 'your-bots'
      renderPage(App, req, res, {
        page: 'worms-drafts',
        heading: 'Worms',
        backButton: false,
        props: {
          navigation: renderNavigation(3, req, App),
          drafts: bots.map((bot) => ({
            id: bot.id,
            name: bot.name,
            nameBase64: Buffer.from(bot.name, 'utf-8').toString('base64'),
            updatedAtFromNow: App.moment(bot.updatedAt)
              .locale(req.lng)
              .fromNow(),
          })),
          lastTestRun: req.session.lastTestRun,
        },
      })
    })
  )

  App.express.post(
    '/worms/drafts/create',
    safeRoute(async (req, res) => {
      const t = getWormsTranslator(App, req)
      if (!req.user) {
        res.redirect('/')
        return
      }

      if (App.config.demos.includes(req.user.name)) {
        res.status(403).send('forbidden')
        return
      }

      const name = req.body?.name ? req.body.name.toString() : ''

      const result = await App.wormsData.createBot({
        userId: req.user.id,
        name,
        code: getDefaultBotCode(t),
      })

      if (!result.ok) {
        if (result.reason === 'invalid-name') {
          res.send(t('worms.management.invalidBotName'))
        } else if (result.reason === 'name-exists') {
          res.send(t('worms.management.botNameExists'))
        } else if (result.reason === 'limit-reached') {
          res.send(t('worms.management.botLimit'))
        } else {
          res.status(500).send('error')
        }
        return
      }

      res.redirect('/worms/your-bots')
    })
  )

  App.express.post(
    '/worms/drafts/delete',
    safeRoute(async (req, res) => {
      if (!req.user) {
        res.redirect('/')
        return
      }

      const id = req.body?.id ? parseInt(req.body.id.toString()) : NaN

      if (isNaN(id)) {
        res.sendStatus(400)
        return
      }

      await App.wormsData.deleteBot({ userId: req.user.id, botId: id })

      res.sendStatus(200)
    })
  )

  App.express.post(
    '/worms/drafts/rename',
    safeRoute(async (req, res) => {
      if (!req.user) {
        res.redirect('/')
        return
      }

      const id = req.body?.id ? parseInt(req.body.id.toString()) : NaN
      const name = req.body?.name ? req.body.name.toString() : ''

      if (isNaN(id) || !name || name.length > 32) {
        res.sendStatus(400)
        return
      }

      const result = await App.wormsData.renameBot({
        userId: req.user.id,
        botId: id,
        name,
      })

      if (!result.ok) {
        res.sendStatus(404)
        return
      }

      res.sendStatus(200)
    })
  )

  App.express.get(
    '/worms/drafts/edit',
    safeRoute(async (req, res) => {
      const t = getWormsTranslator(App, req)
      if (!req.user) {
        res.redirect('/')
        return
      }

      const id = req.query.id ? parseInt(req.query.id.toString()) : NaN

      if (isNaN(id)) {
        res.send(t('worms.management.invalidId'))
        return
      }

      const bot = await App.wormsData.getBotForUser(id, req.user.id)

      if (!bot) {
        res.send(t('worms.management.botNotFound'))
        return
      }

      const code = await App.wormsData.getBotCode(bot.id)

      if (code == null) {
        res.send(t('worms.management.botNotFound'))
        return
      }

      const initialCode = isUntouchedTemplate(App, code)
        ? getDefaultBotCode(t)
        : code

      renderPage(App, req, res, {
        page: 'worms-drafts-edit',
        heading: t('worms.management.editBot') + ' - ' + bot.name,
        backButton: false,
        outsideOfContainer: true,
        props: {
          botName: bot.name,
          botId: bot.id,
          initialCodeJson: toScriptJson(initialCode),
        },
      })
    })
  )

  App.express.post(
    '/worms/drafts/save',
    safeRoute(async (req, res) => {
      const t = getWormsTranslator(App, req)
      if (!req.user) {
        res.redirect('/')
        return
      }

      const id = req.body?.id ? parseInt(req.body.id.toString()) : NaN

      if (isNaN(id)) {
        res.send(t('worms.management.invalidId'))
        return
      }

      const code = req.body?.code ? req.body.code.toString() : ''

      const result = await App.wormsData.saveBotCode({
        userId: req.user.id,
        botId: id,
        code,
      })

      if (!result.ok) {
        if (result.reason === 'code-too-long') {
          res.send(t('worms.management.codeTooLong'))
        } else if (result.reason === 'not-found') {
          res.send(t('worms.management.botNotFound'))
        } else {
          res.sendStatus(400)
        }
        return
      }

      res.send('ok')
    })
  )

  App.express.get(
    '/worms/your-bots/test-run',
    safeRoute(async (req, res) => {
      const t = getWormsTranslator(App, req)
      if (!req.user) {
        res.redirect('/')
        return
      }

      // 'me' instead of a bot id: the user plays this side with the keyboard
      const rHuman = req.query.rId == 'me'
      const gHuman = req.query.gId == 'me'
      const rId = req.query.rId ? parseInt(req.query.rId.toString()) : NaN
      const gId = req.query.gId ? parseInt(req.query.gId.toString()) : NaN

      if ((isNaN(rId) && !rHuman) || (isNaN(gId) && !gHuman)) {
        res.send(t('worms.management.missingIds'))
        return
      }

      // two humans: that's the 2-player mode
      if (rHuman && gHuman) {
        res.redirect('/worms/two-player')
        return
      }

      const rBot = rHuman
        ? null
        : await App.wormsData.getBotForUser(rId, req.user.id)
      const gBot = gHuman
        ? null
        : await App.wormsData.getBotForUser(gId, req.user.id)

      if ((!rBot && !rHuman) || (!gBot && !gHuman)) {
        res.send(t('worms.management.botNotFound'))
        return
      }

      let rCode = ''
      let gCode = ''

      if (rBot) {
        rCode = (await App.wormsData.getBotCode(rBot.id)) ?? ''
      }

      if (gBot) {
        gCode = (await App.wormsData.getBotCode(gBot.id)) ?? ''
      }

      req.session.lastTestRun = [rHuman ? 'me' : rId, gHuman ? 'me' : gId]

      const repeat = req.query.repeat
        ? parseInt(req.query.repeat.toString())
        : NaN

      const human = rHuman ? 'red' : gHuman ? 'green' : null

      if (!isNaN(repeat) && !human && rBot && gBot) {
        renderPage(App, req, res, {
          page: 'worms-test-run-headless',
          backButton: false,
          title: t('worms.testRun.title') + ' (headless)',
          props: {
            rBot,
            gBot,
            repeat,
            rCode: toScriptJson(rCode),
            gCode: toScriptJson(gCode),
          },
        })
        return
      }

      renderPage(App, req, res, {
        page: 'worms-test-run',
        backButton: false,
        title: t('worms.testRun.title'),
        props: {
          rBot,
          gBot,
          human,
          wormerMessages: wormerMessages(t),
          rCode: toScriptJson(rCode),
          gCode: toScriptJson(gCode),
        },
      })
    })
  )
}
```

`src/content/worms/worms-runner.js`:

```js
import { getQuickJS } from 'quickjs-emscripten'

/**
 * Standalone server-side worms runner
 * @param {string} srcRed
 * @param {string} srcGreen
 * @param {(steps: number) => void} [onStep]
 * @param {{ onStart?: (start: import('../../data/types.js').WormsStart) => void, onMove?: (dir: number) => void }} [hooks]
 * @returns {Promise<import('../../data/types.js').WormsReplay>}
 */
export async function runWorms(
  srcRed,
  srcGreen,
  onStep = () => {},
  { onStart = () => {}, onMove = () => {} } = {}
) {
  const offsets = [
    [0, -1],
    [1, 0],
    [0, 1],
    [-1, 0],
  ]

  /** @type {number[][]} */
  const board = []
  for (let x = 0; x < 74; x++) {
    const col = []
    for (let y = 0; y < 42; y++) {
      if (x == 0 || y == 0 || x == 73 || y == 41) {
        col.push(-1)
      } else {
        col.push(0)
      }
    }
    board.push(col)
  }

  let xRed = 10 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 8 - 4)
  let yRed = 20 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 8 - 4)
  let dirRed = Math.floor(Math.random() * 3)

  let xGreen = 61 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 8 - 4)
  let yGreen = 21 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 8 - 4)
  let dirGreen = (Math.floor(Math.random() * 3) + 2) % 4

  board[xRed][yRed] = 1
  board[xGreen][yGreen] = 2

  /** @type {import('../../data/types.js').WormsReplay} */
  const replay = {
    xRed,
    yRed,
    dirRed,
    xGreen,
    yGreen,
    dirGreen,
    dirs: [],
    winner: '',
    redElo: -1,
    greenElo: -1,
  }

  onStart({ xRed, yRed, dirRed, xGreen, yGreen, dirGreen })

  const QuickJS = await getQuickJS()

  const runtimeRed = QuickJS.newRuntime()
  runtimeRed.setMemoryLimit(1024 * 640)
  runtimeRed.setMaxStackSize(1024 * 320)
  let cyclesRed = { val: 0 }
  runtimeRed.setInterruptHandler(() => {
    return cyclesRed.val++ > 101
  })
  const ctxRed = runtimeRed.newContext()

  // ---------------------------------------
  const logHandleRed = ctxRed.newFunction('log', (...args) => {
    // no-op
  })
  const consoleHandleRed = ctxRed.newObject()
  ctxRed.setProp(consoleHandleRed, 'log', logHandleRed)
  ctxRed.setProp(ctxRed.global, 'console', consoleHandleRed)
  consoleHandleRed.dispose()
  logHandleRed.dispose()
  // -------------------------

  try {
    ctxRed.evalCode(srcRed)
  } catch (e) {
    console.log(e)
  }

  const runtimeGreen = QuickJS.newRuntime()
  runtimeGreen.setMemoryLimit(1024 * 640)
  runtimeGreen.setMaxStackSize(1024 * 320)

  let cyclesGreen = { val: 0 }
  runtimeGreen.setInterruptHandler(() => {
    return cyclesGreen.val++ > 101
  })
  const ctxGreen = runtimeGreen.newContext()

  // ---------------------------------------
  const logHandleGreen = ctxGreen.newFunction('log', (...args) => {
    // no-op
  })
  const consoleHandleGreen = ctxGreen.newObject()
  ctxGreen.setProp(consoleHandleGreen, 'log', logHandleGreen)
  ctxGreen.setProp(ctxGreen.global, 'console', consoleHandleGreen)
  consoleHandleGreen.dispose()
  logHandleGreen.dispose()
  // -------------------------

  try {
    ctxGreen.evalCode(srcGreen)
  } catch (e) {
    console.log(e)
  }

  let steps = 0

  // todo: provide console.log in context

  while (!replay.winner) {
    steps++
    onStep(steps)

    const callScriptRed = `
      think(74, 42, ${JSON.stringify(board)}, ${xRed}, ${yRed}, ${dirRed}, ${xGreen}, ${yGreen});
    `
    let newDirRed = -1
    try {
      cyclesRed.val = 0
      const resultRed = ctxRed.unwrapResult(ctxRed.evalCode(callScriptRed))
      newDirRed = ctxRed.getNumber(resultRed)
      resultRed.dispose()
      // console.log('red cycles (10k)', cyclesRed.val)
    } catch {}
    if (
      !(
        newDirRed === 0 ||
        newDirRed === 1 ||
        newDirRed === 2 ||
        newDirRed === 3
      )
    ) {
      const moves = [0, 1, 2, 3].filter((d) => {
        const nx = xRed + offsets[d][0]
        const ny = yRed + offsets[d][1]
        return board[nx][ny] == 0
      })
      if (moves.length == 0) {
        newDirRed = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4)
      } else {
        newDirRed = moves[Math.floor(Math.random() * moves.length)]
      }
    }
    dirRed = newDirRed
    replay.dirs.push(newDirRed)
    onMove(newDirRed)
    const nrx = xRed + offsets[dirRed][0]
    const nry = yRed + offsets[dirRed][1]
    if (board[nrx][nry] == 0) {
      xRed = nrx
      yRed = nry
      board[xRed][yRed] = 1
    } else {
      replay.winner = 'green'
      break
    }

    const callScriptGreen = `
      think(74, 42, ${JSON.stringify(board)}, ${xGreen}, ${yGreen}, ${dirGreen}, ${xRed}, ${yRed});
    `
    let newDirGreen = -1
    try {
      //console.time('green')
      cyclesGreen.val = 0
      const resultGreen = ctxGreen.unwrapResult(
        ctxGreen.evalCode(callScriptGreen)
      )
      newDirGreen = ctxGreen.getNumber(resultGreen)
      resultGreen.dispose()
      //console.log('cycles green', cyclesGreen.val)
      //console.timeEnd('green')
    } catch {}
    if (
      !(
        newDirGreen === 0 ||
        newDirGreen === 1 ||
        newDirGreen === 2 ||
        newDirGreen === 3
      )
    ) {
      const moves = [0, 1, 2, 3].filter((d) => {
        const nx = xGreen + offsets[d][0]
        const ny = yGreen + offsets[d][1]
        return board[nx][ny] == 0
      })
      if (moves.length == 0) {
        newDirGreen = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4)
      } else {
        newDirGreen = moves[Math.floor(Math.random() * moves.length)]
      }
    }
    dirGreen = newDirGreen
    replay.dirs.push(newDirGreen)
    onMove(newDirGreen)
    const ngx = xGreen + offsets[dirGreen][0]
    const ngy = yGreen + offsets[dirGreen][1]
    if (board[ngx][ngy] == 0) {
      xGreen = ngx
      yGreen = ngy
      board[xGreen][yGreen] = 2
    } else {
      replay.winner = 'red'
      break
    }
  }

  try {
    ctxRed.dispose()
    ctxGreen.dispose()

    runtimeRed.dispose()
    runtimeGreen.dispose()
  } catch {}

  return replay
}
```

`src/content/worms/worms-worker.js`:

```js
import { parentPort, workerData } from 'node:worker_threads'
import { runWorms } from './worms-runner.js'

const progress = new Int32Array(workerData.progress)

try {
  const replay = await runWorms(
    workerData.redCode,
    workerData.greenCode,
    (steps) => {
      Atomics.store(progress, 0, steps)
    },
    {
      onStart: (start) => parentPort?.postMessage({ type: 'start', start }),
      onMove: (dir) => parentPort?.postMessage({ type: 'move', dir }),
    }
  )
  parentPort?.postMessage({ type: 'done', ok: true, replay })
} catch (e) {
  parentPort?.postMessage({ type: 'done', ok: false, error: String(e) })
}
```

```js
/**
 *

export async function customMapHtmlCreator({ App, req, solved }) {
  if (!req.user) return ''

  const showAll =
    App.config.editors.includes(req.user.name) ||
    App.config.demos.includes(req.user.name)

  const mapMeta = await App.mapMeta.get(req.user.id)

  const logbookVisible = showAll || mapMeta.storiesAvailable.length > 0 // any story available
  const enoughVisible = showAll || mapMeta.storiesAvailable.includes(4) // story 4 available
  const musicVisible = showAll || mapMeta.storiesAvailable.includes(5) // story 5 available

  const hackerQuizVisible =
    showAll || req.user.score >= 100 || mapMeta.storiesAvailable.includes(3)
  const wwwmVisible = req.user.score >= 150 || showAll
  const mortalCoilVisible = req.user.score >= 200 || showAll
  const wormsVisible = req.user.score >= 250 || showAll
  const pleaseFixMeVisible = req.user.score >= 300 || showAll

  const showWwwmLocked = !wwwmVisible && hackerQuizVisible
  const showMortalcoilLocked = wwwmVisible && !mortalCoilVisible
  const showWormsLocked = mortalCoilVisible && !wormsVisible
  const showPleaseFixMeLocked = wormsVisible && !pleaseFixMeVisible

  let numberOfQuizzes = App.quizData.numberOfQuizzes()
  let quizzesCompleted = 0
  for (const id of mapMeta.quizzesCompleted) {
    if (App.quizData.hasQuizById(id)) {
      quizzesCompleted++
    }
  }

  const percentQuizzesCompleted =
    numberOfQuizzes > 0
      ? Math.round((quizzesCompleted / numberOfQuizzes) * 100)
      : 0

  let mortalcoillevel = 0

  if (mortalCoilVisible) {
    const raw = parseInt(
      (await App.storage.getItem(`mortalcoil_${req.user.id}`)) ?? 'NaN'
    )
    if (!isNaN(raw)) {
      mortalcoillevel = raw
    }
  }

  let wwwm_win = false
  if (wwwmVisible) {
    if (await App.storage.getItem(`wwwm-win-${req.user.id}`)) {
      wwwm_win = true
    }
  }

  let output = ''

      </div>`
  }

  if (showMortalcoilLocked) {

            var easy = document.getElementById('show-easy');

            document.body.classList.toggle('hide-medium', !medium.checked);
            document.body.classList.toggle('hide-hard', !hard.checked);

            }

          var easyCb = document.getElementById('show-easy');
          var mediumCb = document.getElementById('show-medium');
          var hardCb = document.getElementById('show-hard');

          if (easyCb) easyCb.addEventListener('change', applyVisibility);
          if (mediumCb) mediumCb.addEventListener('change', applyVisibility);
          if (hardCb) hardCb.addEventListener('change', applyVisibility);

          // Initialize based on current checkbox states
          applyVisibility();
        })();
      </script>

  return `

    <span style="position:absolute; left:680px; top:1680px;z-index:-2; font-size:8px;">&#87;&#65;&#76;&#68;&#79;</span>
    ${output}
  `
}
```

`src/data/types.ts`:

```ts
import Moment from 'moment'
import express, { Request } from 'express'
import { appConfig } from './config.js'
import {
  CreationOptional,
  InferAttributes,
  InferCreationAttributes,
  Model,
  ModelStatic,
  Sequelize,
} from 'sequelize'
import { i18n } from 'i18next'
import type { Server as HttpServer } from 'node:http'
import type { Server as SocketServer } from 'socket.io'

export interface App {
  config: typeof appConfig
  entry: {
    add(fn: () => void | Promise<void>): void
    start(): Promise<void>
  }
  logger: {
    info(msg: string): void
    warn(msg: string): void
  }
  moment: typeof Moment
  express: ReturnType<typeof express>
  httpServer: HttpServer
  io: SocketServer
  db: Sequelize & {
    models: {
      User: ModelStatic<UserModel>
      Solution: ModelStatic<SolutionModel>
      Session: ModelStatic<SessionModel>
      Room: ModelStatic<RoomModel>
      KVPair: ModelStatic<KVPairModel>
      WormsBotDraft: ModelStatic<WormsBotDraftModel>
      WormsArenaMatch: ModelStatic<WormsArenaMatchModel>
      Event: ModelStatic<EventModel>
    }
  }
  i18n: { get(lng: 'de' | 'en'): i18n }
  csrf: {
    create(req: Request): string
    verify(req: Request, token: string): boolean
  }
  periodic: {
    add(interval: number, fn: () => void): void
  }
  challenges: {
    data: HtwChallenge[]
    dataMap: { [key: number]: HtwChallenge }
    distance: { [key: number]: number }
    getTitle(cid: number, req: Request): string
  }
  storage: {
    setItem(key: string, value: string): Promise<void>
    getItem(key: string): Promise<string | null>
    removeItem(key: string): Promise<void>
  }
  challengeStats: {
    getData(cid: number): Promise<ChallengeStatsData> | ChallengeStatsData
    refreshData(cid: number): Promise<void>
    nuke: () => void
  }
  version: string
  event: {
    create: (key: string, userId: number) => Promise<void>
  }
  chat: {
    complete: (messages: Message[]) => Promise<string>
  }
  experiments: {
    getStatus(
      id: number,
      req: Request
    ): null | { status: 'base' | 'trial'; experimentId: number }
    showTrial(id: number, req: Request): boolean
    withExperiment(id: number): boolean
  }
  metrics: {
    total_requests: number
    bucket_50ms: number
    bucket_100ms: number
```

`src/external-wrapper/flash.js`:

```js
// @ts-nocheck

// External module, copied from node_modules/connect-flash/lib/flash.js
import { format } from 'util'
/**
 * Expose `flash()` function on requests.
 *
 * @return {Function}
 * @api public
 */
export function flash() {
  return function (req, res, next) {
    if (req.flash) {
      return next()
    }
    req.flash = _flash
    next()
  }
}

/**
 * Queue flash `msg` of the given `type`.
 *
 * Examples:
 *
 *      req.flash('info', 'email sent');
 *      req.flash('error', 'email delivery failed');
 *      req.flash('info', 'email re-sent');
 *      // => 2
 *
 *      req.flash('info');
 *      // => ['email sent', 'email re-sent']
 *
 *      req.flash('info');
 *      // => []
 *
 *      req.flash();
 *      // => { error: ['email delivery failed'], info: [] }
 *
 * Formatting:
 *
 * Flash notifications also support arbitrary formatting support.
 * For example you may pass variable arguments to `req.flash()`
 * and use the %s specifier to be replaced by the associated argument:
 *
 *     req.flash('info', 'email has been sent to %s.', userName);
 *
 * Formatting uses `util.format()`, which is available on Node 0.6+.
 *
 * @param {String} type
 * @param {String} msg
 * @return {Array|Object|Number}
 * @api public
 */
function _flash(type, msg) {
  if (this.session === undefined) throw Error('req.flash() requires sessions')
  var msgs = (this.session.flash = this.session.flash || {})
  if (type && msg) {
    // util.format is available in Node.js 0.6+
    if (arguments.length > 2 && format) {
      var args = Array.prototype.slice.call(arguments, 1)
      msg = format.apply(undefined, args)
    } else if (Array.isArray(msg)) {
      msg.forEach(function (val) {
        ;(msgs[type] = msgs[type] || []).push(val)
      })
      return msgs[type].length
    }
    return (msgs[type] = msgs[type] || []).push(msg)
  } else if (type) {
    var arr = msgs[type]
    delete msgs[type]
    return arr || []
  } else {
    this.session.flash = {}
    return msgs
  }
}
```
